title: The Moss Saucer for the Fern
youtube_title: The Moss Saucer for the Fern | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Pilar wants to check on a saucer of moss meant for a tiny fern before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Pilar leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
